text:
rita: FYI rolled the new cipher-whitelist (TLS1.2+, ECDHE-only) to prod at 03:30 UTC across regions. Seeing a spike in handshake failures from apac-proxy and legacy-ingress. I'm pausing and starting rollback now.

deploy-bot: rollout started: cipher-whitelist v2 -> prod (canary none: global) :rotating_light:

ashok: seeing this in apac-proxy logs: `tls handshake error: remote error: tls: handshake failure` then `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` — seems like cert chain verification failing after we removed RSA fallback.

sam: I also see KMS unwrap errors around the same time for cert-rotator in apac: `AccessDeniedException: not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:apac:...:key/xxxx` — cert-rotator couldn't unwrap private key.

rita: hmm, did the RBAC/KMS grant change coincide? We only intended to change TLS config.

ashok: quick grep of recent infra commits shows a RoleBinding tidy that removed `secretstore:write` for `cert-rotator-sa` in apac clusters. committing author: @leo. Could be simultaneous.

leo: yeah I trimmed a stale cluster-role yesterday; I didn't realize cert-rotator relied on the legacy `secretstore:write` role in apac. My bad. I can reapply the RoleBinding.

sam: adding logs: `2026-03-20T03:31:12Z cert-rotator apac pod/cert-rotator-7f8d: failed to unwrap key: AccessDeniedException` then `2026-03-20T03:31:15Z proxy apac ingress: TLS verify failed: certificate verify failed (unknown authority)` — sequence looks like rotator failed -> old certs not rotated -> clients hit RSA-signed chains that we just blacklisted.

sarah: for immediate mitigation we should: 1) regrant secretstore write to cert-rotator-sa in apac, 2) restore KMS grant for CertSigningKey to allow Decrypt/DescribeKey for rotator principal, 3) rollback cipher whitelist to include ECDHE-RSA fallback so old certs still work during rotation.

rita: agree. I'm reverting the cipher policy to include ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256 as a safe fallback across regions. Doing a targeted canary to us-west first.

deploy-bot: rollback started: cipher-whitelist v2 -> v1-fallback (canary: us-west-2)

leo: reapplying RoleBinding now: `kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: cert-rotator-write-apac
  namespace: infra
roleRef:
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: secretstore-writer
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: cert-rotator-sa
  namespace: infra
EOF`

ashok: I pushed a KMS grant request to the infra account: `aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/cert-signing --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::infra:role/cert-rotator --operations Decrypt DescribeKey` — pending approver.

sam: also noticed audit logs for cert writes in apac are sparse around the incident window. `s3://infra-audit/apac/2026/03/20/03/` only has TTL-check events, not secret writes. Audit agent kube-audit seems to have dropped events for the infra namespace due to a filter rule change in the configmap 03:00 UTC.

audit-bot: configmap/kube-audit updated by leo at 03:02 UTC (filter: drop namespace=infra) :white_check_mark:

leo: that was me; I added that filter to reduce noise but didn't consider cert-rotator writes. Rolling back the filter now.

sarah: action items (short):
- leo: revert kube-audit filter (apac) and reapply RoleBinding (in progress)
- ashok: follow up on KMS grant approval and confirm Decrypt access
- rita: manage rollback canary + monitor handshake error rate (SLO: <0.1% handshake failures)
- sam: replay missing audit events if possible and backfill to s3/alerts.
- ops-sre (cc): increase retention on audit S3 for 7 days for triage window.

sam: for auditing/backfill: we can replay from kube-apiserver logs in apac nodes; will try to correlate pod-level events and reconstruct write attempts.

rita: current status: canary us-west rolled back, handshake failures there dropped to baseline. apac still flaky until RBAC/KMS are sorted.

ashok: KMS grant approved. Verified with `aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/cert-signing`: grant present for cert-rotator role. Rotator logs now show successful unwrap: `successfully unwrapped key, rotating cert`

sam: kube-audit filter reverted and we have a clean stream of secret write events again. Backfilling initial hour now.

leo: RoleBinding reapplied and cert-rotator pods restarted; they pulled new certs and reported healthy.

rita: thanks all. Post-incident remediation proposals:
- make cipher whitelist changes tied to a cert-rotator health check: rollout refuses to enforce RSA-drop unless rotator reports >=95% success last 1h.
- add a canary per-region by default for TLS policy rollouts (not global instantaneous).
- RBAC change PRs that touch infra namespaces must include a checklist entry: "verify cert-rotator & secretstore perms" and require 1 approver from security.
- audit filter rule edits auto-trigger a dry-run that lists dropped event types and requires ack.

rita: also opening an incident ticket and postmortem. tagging eng-oncall and product-security. please add any missing notes to the ticket.

leo: sorry again for the surprise noise. I'll link the RoleBinding diff and the kube-audit change in the ticket.

ashok: vuln triage note: this incident surfaced that legacy-ingress still depends on RSA cert chains. Recommend a forced migration timeline for any consumer still using RSA chains (60 days).

sam: added: monitoring alert tweak: alert if cert-rotator unwrap failures > 3 in 5m for any region.

rita: closing thread; will post the incident timeline in #incidents and share postmortem draft later today. :thumbsup:
